releases.notes: # **Vesper Wilds Changelog - Versions 0.0.19 & 0.0.20** The latter update was pushed to github, but not released as a distributed mod. Showing changes for both versions here. **Download Links:** ### Added - Vesperite Lantern: A new utility block that prevents hostile mobs from spawning within a 16-block radius. - Vesperite Tools: Added a full toolset (Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Sword, Hoe). - Stats: Slightly faster than Iron with similar durability and mining level. - Vesperite Ingot: New crafting material for Vesperite tools. - New Vegetation: Added Ember Shelf Fungus, Vesper Sprouts, and Velvet Fern. - Note: Ember Shelf Fungus emits a low light level to provide ambiance on Velvet Trees. - Vesper Stone Family: A new stone type exclusive to the Vesper Grove (currently replaces Tuff blob generation). - Note: Cobbled variant is disabled for now. - Datagen Support: Added new datagen files for the en_us language file to streamline localization. ### Changed - Biome Aesthetics: Adjusted the Vesper Grove grass color to match the purple/blue biome palette (replacing the standard green). - Leaf Physics: Fixed the falling leaf particles from Velvet Leaves; they now drift down slowly rather than falling too quickly. - Generation Fixes: Resolved an issue where Vesper Sprouts and Velvet Ferns would generate in the same block space. - Texture Fix: Updated the Vesper Sprouts model to resolve a null texture error. ### Removed - Glow Squids: Temporarily disabled spawning in the biome due to excessive spawn rates. - Vanilla Stones: Removed Granite, Diorite, and Andesite generation from the Vesper Grove to allow for cleaner underground development.
